import { BattleFormatGui } from '@src/utils/battleMemoryMessage';
import { useMessage } from '@src/utils/useMessage';
/**
 * 打劫
 * 指令：/打劫 UID 或 /打劫 @目标
 *
 * 消耗：15 元力/次
 * 每日上限：5 次
 * 胜利：从被劫者扣除灵石×100 + 灵晶×10，转移给打劫者 + 煞气+1
 * 失败：无奖励
 */

import App from '@src/response-apps/robbery/app';
import { createBackendRequestContext } from '@src/api/bot/context';
import { selects } from '@src/response/config';
import { FormatGui } from '@src/utils/messageHelper';
import { resolveTargetUid } from '@src/utils/targetUid';
import { Format, onResponse, useMention } from 'alemonjs';

export default onResponse(selects, async e => {
  const [message] = useMessage();
  const [mention] = useMention();
  const bid = e?.UserId;
  const uid = e.uid as number;
  const isPrivate = e.isPrivate ?? false;

  try {
    const targetUid = await resolveTargetUid(e.MessageText, mention);

    if (!targetUid || targetUid <= 0) {
      const md = Format.createMarkdown();

      md.addText('请正确输入指令，示例：/打劫 UID 或 /打劫 @目标');

      void message.send(FormatGui({ isPrivate, bid, title: '', content: md }));

      return;
    }

    const appResult = await App({ bid, uid, targetUid, request: createBackendRequestContext(e) });

    if (appResult.code !== 'OK') {
      const md = Format.createMarkdown();

      md.addText(appResult.data.message);

      void message.send(FormatGui({ isPrivate, bid, title: '', content: md }));

      return;
    }

    const result = appResult.data;
    // 战斗完成，展示结果
    const md = Format.createMarkdown();
    const br = result.battleView;
    const sideACount = br.finalState.sideA.length;
    const sideBCount = br.finalState.sideB.length;

    md.addText(`目标：${result.targetName}`);
    md.addNewline();
    md.addText(`胜负：${result.winner === 'A' ? '✅ 打劫成功' : '❌ 打劫失败'}`);
    md.addNewline();
    md.addBlockquote(
      Format.createMarkdown()
        .addText(`战斗类型：${sideACount}v${sideBCount},回合数：${br.totalRounds}`)
        .addNewline()
        .addText(`消耗元力：${result.qiCost},今日剩余：${result.remaining}/${result.dailyMax}`)
    );

    if (result.winner === 'A') {
      md.addNewline();
      const loot: string[] = [];

      if (result.stoneReward) {
        loot.push(`灵石+${result.stoneReward}`);
      }
      if (result.crystalReward) {
        loot.push(`灵晶+${result.crystalReward}`);
      }
      md.addText(loot.length > 0 ? `💰 ${loot.join(',')}` : '💰 对方身无分文');
      md.addNewline();
      md.addText(`😈 煞气：+${result.shaQiChange}（当前${result.currentShaQi}）`);
      md.addNewline();

      if (result.bonusText) {
        md.addBlockquote(Format.createMarkdown().addText(result.bonusText));
      }

      if (result.droppedItem) {
        md.addText(`🎁 掉落：${result.droppedItem.name}×${result.droppedItem.quantity}（${result.droppedItem.category}）`);
        md.addNewline();
      }
    }

    // 无论胜败显示修为
    if (result.experience && result.experience > 0) {
      md.addText(`📖 获得修为：+${result.experience}`);
      md.addNewline();
    }

    // 连败提示
    if (result.losingStreakText) {
      md.addText(result.losingStreakText);
      md.addNewline();
    }

    // 底部按钮
    md.addNewline();

    void message.send(
      await BattleFormatGui(
        {
          isPrivate,
          bid,
          title: '打劫',
          content: md,
          footer: [
            { label: '文字记录', command: `/查看战斗过程 ${result.battleLogId}` },
            { label: '打劫记录', command: '/打劫记录' },
          ]
        },
        [{ id: result.battleLogId }]
      )
    );

    // ── 群播报（纯MD，不@用户，不带按钮）──
    if (!isPrivate && result.winner === 'A') {
      const broadcastMd = Format.createMarkdown();
      const lootParts: string[] = [];

      if (result.stoneReward) {
        lootParts.push(`灵石×${result.stoneReward}`);
      }
      if (result.crystalReward) {
        lootParts.push(`灵晶×${result.crystalReward}`);
      }
      if (result.droppedItem) {
        lootParts.push(`${result.droppedItem.name}×${result.droppedItem.quantity}`);
      }
      const lootText = lootParts.length > 0 ? lootParts.join('、') : '一无所获';

      broadcastMd.addText(`⚔️ ${result.attackerName} 打劫了 ${result.targetName}，掠夺了${lootText}！`);
      void message.send({
        format: (() => {
          const f = Format.create();

          f.addMarkdown(broadcastMd);

          return f;
        })()
      });
    }
  } catch {
    const md = Format.createMarkdown();

    md.addText('打劫失败，请稍后再试');

    void message.send(FormatGui({ isPrivate, bid, title: '', content: md }));
  }
});
